owner_decision: Reserve USB devices for ADB while USB debugging is enabled. Disabling debugging and refreshing discovery releases the mode reservation; no new ADB session lock is introduced.
behavior: Native active-configuration observation reports Available, Debugging, or Unknown. Shared view and controller deny unavailable rows. Selected native handles recheck before reset, AOA transfers and interface claim; unavailable configuration rejects. Current BLUI v2 and control codec replace the old wire formats.

native_observation.method: Read-only rebuilt helper --list 64; no claims, mode switches or resets

ownership.owner: Existing supervised helper owns libusb handles, context and physical-port lock until process retirement. New policy owns one temporary active-configuration allocation per call.
ownership.bounds: 512 candidates; fixed 16-byte inventory records; one availability byte. Library-validated descriptor arrays are borrowed only during classification.
ownership.handoff: Configuration freed exactly once on successful lookup; error returns Unknown without publishing a borrowed pointer. Snapshot carries only a copied enum.
ownership.cutoff: Recheck exact opened handle before native effect; stale optimistic inventory cannot authorize debugging-enabled device. Broker link retirement still controls existing ownership.
ownership.settlement: No new asynchronous workers, retained state, callbacks or ADB mappings; existing helper admission and process retirement remain authoritative. No status timeout unlocks a debugging reservation.
ownership.validation: Permanent descriptor boundary/property tests, exact release fixture, unknown errors, mode-switch/reset forbidden-effect counters, shared controller refresh and widget disabled-action tests; ASan/UBSan enabled.

limits: Physical debugging-off transition not performed; automated refresh/descriptor tests cover release.
